LanguageData.MST.selectionWeightPerPointsCurveComment: Relative weight of this strategy being chosen at a given raid point value. X axis: points, Y axis: weight.
LanguageData.MST.minPawnsComment: Expected minimum raider count. Total points are divided by it to cap the cost of a single pawn, so raising it means more raiders but fewer elites (vanilla siege uses 4, most others 1).
LanguageData.MST.pawnsCanBringFoodComment: Whether raiders under this strategy may carry food. Friendly factions ignore this.
LanguageData.MST.raidLootValueFactorComment: Multiplier applied to raid loot value for this strategy, on top of the difficulty loot factor.
LanguageData.MST.arriveModesComment: Arrival modes this strategy may use. Clearing it makes the strategy unselectable on any map.
